title: Daintree National Park
get_in:
[[File:Daintree ferry - Fähre (22865124080).jpg|thumb|200px|The ferry crossing to Cape Trib]]
===By car===
The most accessible way to the world's oldest living rainforest is via car. 

From [[Cairns]], use State Route 44 Captain Cook Highway from either [[Highway 1 (Australia)|National Route 1]] or State Route 91, passing through Port Douglas continue until you reach the town of Mossman. Once you have arrived at Mossman, you have basically arrived at the forest, but the routes divert into two. If you are heading to the Mossman Gorge, turn onto Johnston Road, and if you're heading north to places like Daintree Village or Cape Trib, continue straight.

If you want to get to Cape Tribulation, take the [https://daintreeferry.com.au/ Daintree River Ferry]. Once you have crossed the river, the road heads north and most of the places of interest are along the way.
*Ferry tickets (as of Sep 2025) one-way/return: car $31/51, bicycle $6/7, motorcycle $13/20.

===By bus===
[https://www.transnorthbus.com.au/bus-services TransNorthBus services] has bus services from [[Cairns]] to Wonga.
